help.faq_q1: How do I share my pet's history with a vet?
help.faq_a1: Open the pet, tap "Share with vet" and generate a temporary access code. The vet uses this code on the web portal (vet.petdiary.com.br) and gets access for 24 hours. You can revoke at any time on the pet screen.
help.faq_q2: Who else can access my pet's account?
help.faq_a2: You can invite family members as co-tutors in the "Family" section of the account (available on the web portal). They get full access to the pet and the PRO plan (if you have one), but cannot delete the main account.
help.faq_q3: How does the PRO plan work?
help.faq_a3: PRO costs R$ 14.90/month via PIX. Includes unlimited pets, AI for extracting prescriptions and exams, audio transcription (Whisper), unlimited co-tutors and priority support. Cancel anytime.
help.faq_q4: How do I cancel my subscription?
help.faq_a4: Go to Account > Subscription > Cancel subscription. You keep PRO until the end of the paid period. No fees.
help.faq_a5: Yes. Go to Account > Delete my account. Personal data (name, email, phone, ID, address) is anonymized per GDPR. The pets' clinical history is preserved for authorized co-tutors and vets.
help.faq_q6: I forgot my password. What do I do?
help.faq_a6: Sign out and on the login screen tap "Forgot my password" — you'll receive a link by email (valid for 30 minutes) to create a new one.
help.faq_q7: The AI is making mistakes. Can I correct it?
help.faq_a7: Yes. Every AI extraction can be edited manually in the record. The AI speeds up data entry, but you are the source of truth.
